Method of Attack: Malicious IIS web server module installed on Microsoft Exchange Outlook Web Access servers to steal credentials and execute commands remotely
Logs credentials of users authenticating on OWA login page
Allows remote execution of PowerShell commands via specially crafted inputs in username and password fields
Likely exploits ProxyLogon vulnerabilities to compromise servers
Impacted Systems: Microsoft Exchange Outlook Web Access servers
Attack Vector: Installation of malicious IIS module named 'ExtenderControlDesigner' on Exchange servers
Sending crafted authentication requests to OWA login page
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious module visible via 'appcmd.exe' or IIS configuration tool
PDB paths visible in malware executable
Account on RaidForums hacking forum linked during investigation
